hero.title: Give every dollar
hero.description: Prospera puts your money into envelopes — one per purpose — so you always know what is left to spend. Calm, clear budgeting without the spreadsheet.

budgetFirst.title: Budget before you spend
budgetFirst.body: Plan each month by splitting your income into envelopes. Fixed bills and flexible spending, side by side.

simpleLedger.title: A ledger that stays simple
simpleLedger.body: Log expenses and revenues one line at a time. No double entry, no chart of accounts — just what happened.

visibleEnvelopes.title: Envelopes you can see
visibleEnvelopes.body: Color-coded envelopes show at a glance what is left. When one is empty, you know it is time to stop.

shared.title: Finances, shared
shared.body: Invite a partner or family into a shared profile, with owner, contributor and viewer roles per resource.

closing.title: Know where your money goes — before it goes.
